game.title: Your game
game.heightHint: Only used to show rough centimetres next to measured values.

handicap.label: Handicap (optional)
handicap.invalid: Please enter a number between 0 and 54.

level.title: Score level
level.explain: The level only makes the swing score more forgiving – it widens the tolerances. The targets stay the same for everybody, so a good swing is always a good swing.
level.autoNoHcp: Auto: level {n} until you enter a handicap

defaults.title: When you record
defaults.hint: Preselected on the recording screen – you can change it there every time.

training.title: Training
training.toleranceHint: Applies to the training targets (mirror mode and ball series). 1× is the default.
training.soundHint: Beep when you reach the target position – very helpful when you can't look at the screen.

storage.title: Your data
storage.where: Everything stays on this phone. No account, no server.
storage.savedOk: ✓ Swings are saved on this phone
storage.savedNo: ✕ Not saved in this mode (private browsing) – everything is gone when you close the app.
storage.unknown: Storage use unknown on this phone
storage.persisted: ✓ Protected – the browser won't clear your swings on its own
storage.persistWhy: If your phone runs low on space, or you haven't opened the app for a while, Safari may clear website data – including your swings. Protected storage asks the browser to keep it. Adding the app to your home screen helps too.
storage.persistDenied: The browser said no for now. Add the app to your home screen and try again.
storage.persistUnsupported: This browser can't protect storage. Add the app to your home screen – that keeps data much longer.
storage.homeScreen: Tip: Share ↑ → "Add to Home Screen" – then the app works like a normal app, also offline.
storage.deleteText: All swings, videos, training targets, progress and settings are deleted from this phone. This cannot be undone.

about.title: About
about.prototype: This is a prototype to explore ideas for the product. Measurements are approximate and the golf rules are still being reviewed by a coach.
about.offline: Works offline after the first start – the pose detection runs on your phone, no video ever leaves it.
